title: OpenAI’s 372 Math Results: What Has Actually Been Verified So Far
key_facts: On 6 Oct 2026 OpenAI shared more than 700 research papers produced by an internal AI model.
The papers cover results from 372 groups of maths problems in areas such as algebra, geometry, number theory and logic.
OpenAI also released many of the proofs in Lean, a computer language that checks the logic of maths arguments.
The results still need examination by independent mathematicians.
Some researchers have raised concerns about the quality and clarity of the papers.
Reports say OpenAI has since withdrawn three papers.
OpenAI says it will support workshops and conferences to help researchers examine the work.
quote_evidence: The results still need examination by independent mathematicians.
According to reports, OpenAI has subsequently withdrawn three papers
why_it_matters_hint: Hundreds of AI-written maths results are public, but acceptance depends on independent review.
notes: Technology Org (the pool link) returned 403, so the same story was read at Education Times, which does not name its sources for the withdrawal; hedged as 'reports say'.
